# TUTORERA Platform Description

TUTORERA is a global student-led digital tutoring marketplace operated by MENTISERA (SMC-Private) Limited. The platform connects students and parents with verified tutors for online tutoring worldwide and local in-person home tuition where verified tutor inventory and local safeguards are available.

## Core Purpose
TUTORERA enables students to post tuition requirements and receive transparent offers from qualified tutors. The platform uses an 8-layer smart matching engine with Bayesian ratings to recommend compatible tutors. All tutor verifications—including CNIC, education credentials, demo video, and police clearance—are tracked per-component with canonical status computation.

## Key Features
- Student-led tuition request posting with budget and schedule preferences
- Verified tutor directory with match scoring, availability, and structured profiles
- Structured negotiation with max 3 counter-offers per party
- Authorized platform checkout with atomic booking creation, server-side payment verification, and webhook confirmation
- Per-component tutor verification (identity, education, demo video, police)
- Admin control tower with at-risk request rescue, supply-gap intelligence, and financial reconciliation
- Role-based access control with granular permissions (student, tutor, parent, admin)
- Email webhook tracking and delivery monitoring
- Request expiry lifecycle with archival and retention
- Multi-country market configuration (PK, AE, SA, GB, US, CA, AU, QA, OM, KW, BH, IN, MY, SG)
- One-click rebooking with pre-filled tutor, subject, mode, and rate from previous sessions
- Post-session review request automation
- Parent/guardian accounts with child profile management and approval workflows
- Self-service refund request flow for completed bookings
- Guest checkout for parent accounts — parents can pay for their children's bookings
- Pricing intelligence showing market rate ranges per city and subject
- Learning relationship tracking (student-tutor pairs, repeat booking counts, retention metrics)
- First-session satisfaction guarantee with claim workflow

## Demand SEO Pages
TUTORERA generates city×subject×curriculum demand pages for organic discovery:
- /tuition-requests/pk/lahore/mathematics
- /tuition-requests/pk/karachi/physics
- /tuition-requests/pk/islamabad/chemistry
Each page surfaces anonymized, real request data filtered by city, subject, curriculum, and teaching mode.

## Tutoring Index
Public aggregate market research is also available at /research/tutoring-index with anonymized demand, offer-rate, booking, response-time, city, subject, mode, and six-month trend data.
Public aggregate market research at /research/pakistan-tutoring-rates — anonymized data on tutoring rates by city, subject, mode, and trend over 6 months.
